SUMMARY: the operator approved the GitHub connector boundary against the #396 CSO brief — Phase 2 build is GO.

TASK: the GitHub issues connector as the framework's second implementation per docs/internal/specs/connectors.md Phase 2, proving the plug-point. The eight GH-C controls bind as hard requirements.

title: Connector Phase 2: GitHub issues connector under GH-C01..C08
